title: Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames Arc Reanimated Movie Now Streaming on Netflix Worldwide
content:
Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames Arc reanimated anime movie is now officially streaming on Netflix worldwide. Studio BN Pictures handled the animation, with Naoya Ando as the director. The film premiered in Japan on February 13.

The content of the movie covers the fight against Hosen, and was previously adapted in episodes 139-146 of the anime. Netflix released a new clip to commemorate the streaming premiere.

The new film was presented in cinemascope (aspect ratio 2.35:1). The full staff includes:

• Director: Naoya Ando

• Supervising Director: Youichi Fujita

• Scriptwriter: Taku Kishimoto

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Shinji Takeuchi

• Animation Production: BN Pictures

Hideaki Sorachi wrote and illustrated the Gintama manga, which first ran in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump from 2003 to 2018, and then in their Jump Giga until February 2019.

The Gintama anime adaptation was animated by Sunrise until Season 4, which is when Bandai Namco Pictures took over. The anime has a total of 367 episodes, as well as numerous OVAs, movies, games, novels and specials. The latest installment was the Gintama: The Very Final movie, which premiered in 2021 and served as the definitive conclusion to the anime adaptation by adapting the manga’s final arc. The film had a strong critical and commercial reception, grossing over 1.85 billion yen (approx. USD 17 million) at the domestic box office and ranking among Japan’s highest-earning anime features of that year.
author: Anime Corner

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Katsuyuki Konishi
content:
The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Thursday that Katsuyuki Konishi will join the anime's cast as Hayden, the eldest sibling of the Benfield family.

The anime will star Rikuya Yasuda as the protagonist Theo.

Masato Jinbo ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 2wei! /2wei Herz!/3rei!! , Chaos;Child , The Rising of The Shield Hero Season 2 ) is directing the anime at PartsCraft , and is also supervising the scripts. Hiroshi Yoneda ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Vow in the Snow ) is the character designer and chief animation director.

AI localization company Orange Inc. 's e-bookstore service emaqi licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives.

Kasugai launched the manga in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours magazine in March 2021. Shōnengahōsha released the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 30.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Remarried Empress Series Sets November 4 Debut, Reveals Teaser Trailer
content:
Disney+ announced on Tuesday that its upcoming The Remarried Empress romance fantasy live-action series based on web novel and webtoon of the same name will premiere on November 4. The streaming service also released a teaser trailer and character posters for the series.

The first four episodes will debut on Disney+ and Hulu on November 4, and the services will release two new episodes every Wednesday through the series finale on November 25 (for a total of 10 episodes).

The Remarried Empress revolves around Navier, the perfect Empress of the Eastern Empire, who chooses divorce after discovering that her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, plans to replace her with his mistress. Determined to reclaim her status, Navier resolves to become an Empress in another land.

The teaser highlights the strained relationship between Navier (played by Min-A Shin ), Sovieshu ( Ji-Hoon Ju ), Rashta ( Se Young Lee ), and Heinrey ( Jong Suk Lee ) as the imperial romance develops into a major political and personal conflict.

Suwon Cho is directing the series with scripts by Geena Yeoh and Choong-Yeol Hyun .

The webtoon has over 2.9 billion global views and has been translated into 10 languages. The series has a strong international following, particularly in Japan.

The webtoon ended in January after a seven-year run, but will return this fall for side stories.

The English version of the The Remarried Empress webtoon is available on WEBTOON. Ize Press is releasing the series in print.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Wandance Film Reveals Dance Supervisors for Each Character, Musical Artists, Songs
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Coffee 's Wandance manga revealed on Thursday the dance supervisors for each character, and the full list of music artists and song titles that will be used in the film.

Runa Miura is supervising the dance of Kaboku Kotani (played by &TEAM boy band member JO ), KANU (top right in above image) is in charge of Hikari Wanda (played by Anji Ikehata ), akihic☆彡 (bottom center) is in charge of On Miyao (played by Kira Yamaguchi ) and is also the choreographer for TEAM ON, and KEIN (bottom left) is in charge of Iori Itsukushima (played by Ran Mazzel). SEIYA (bottom right) is in charge of Usen Takumi (played by Aloha Takamatsu ) and is also the choreographer for the SAKAYA CREW.

origami PRODUCTIONS and music producer GuruConnect are in charge of the film's music. Below are all the participating artists and song titles that will be used in the film:

Nenashi

• "Step by Step feat. Sagiri Sól, Kenya Fujita"

From GuruConnect

• "Boom Bang!!"

• "Ghost Dog"

• "Insight"

• "Juice"

• "Karma"

• "Light It Up"

• "New Steps"

• "Move feat. E.V.P"

From SWING-O

• "Pop To The Top feat. MARU"

Naoya Kusaba is directing the film, with a script by Keiichi Kobayashi . Dancer and entrepreneur Charisma Kantarō is supervising the film's dances.

Kodansha USA Publishing releases the manga and describes the story:

A boy named Kaboku sees a girl named Wanda dance, and suddenly burns with a need to join in. With its thrilling scenes of Japanese hip-hop dance and quirky, charming characters, this is a new, inspirational manga for fans of coming-of-age stories like Blue Period and Your Lie in April . Get up and join the Wandance ! Kaboku has always just gone with the flow, marching in step to the drumbeat of the expectations of those around him: parents, school, plans for the future. It feels predictable, safe, and… empty. But one night, Kaboku's at school late, and he happens on a girl alone, moving wildly, turning a blank space of concrete into a canvas. This is Hikari Wanda, a member of the hip-hop dance club. Kaboku is immediately smitten, but the road to stepping out of his shell is a long one. The club is almost entirely girls, and they're all, well, way better than him. What's ahead is unknown, and that's terrifying, but it also means, for the first time in Kaboku's life… a taste of freedom.

Coffee launched the manga in Afternoon magazine in 2019, and is simultaneously publishing the manga in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app. Kodansha published the manga's 15th compiled book volume in December 2025. Kodansha USA Publishing will release the 14th volume in English on November 2026.

A television anime adaptation debuted in Japan in October 2025. Disney+ streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

title: Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun Film Streams 1st 2 Minutes, Casts Shōko Nakagawa
content:
Kadokawa started streaming the first two minutes of the Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun: Ukkari Detekita Uchūjin o Sagase! (Space Academy: Find the Aliens Who Accidentally Came Out!) film based on Yūji Nishimura 's web manga Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun ( Space Academy ) on Thursday. Kadokawa also revealed that Shōko Nakagawa is voicing the various aliens who appear in the film.

The film will open in theaters on September 11.

Nakagawa also performs the film's theme song "Uchū no Nanchara Nakama" (Space Friend).

The film's story centers on space pilot trainee Kotetsu hearing about the possible existence of aliens and driving the whole academy to search for them.

The film will feature both anime footage, as well as real footage of space.

The cast from the television anime will reprise their roles in the film.

Yoshinori Tsutsui is directing the film. Yōichi Katō returns from the television anime to pen the film's script. Kyō Nakanishi and Yuri Habuka are composing the music. Kōhei Chida is credited as the music producer. Kensuke Matsui is credited for sound design. Bit Grooove Promotion is credited for sound production. Fanworks is credited for animation assistance. Science Art, Inc. is credited for video production assistance, and NHK Educational is credited for video production. The Young Astronaut Club-Japan is credited for space supervision.

Nishimura launched the manga on August 6, 2019, just after the 50th anniversary of the first moon landing, and has since posted a chapter every other Monday for free. The manga follows the daily life of Kotetsu-kun, who aspires to be an astronaut, and friends at the Animal Space Academy as they all pursue their dreams.

The weekly anime premiered its first season on NHK Educational in April 2021, and aired until March 2022. The second season premiered in April 2022, and ended in February 2023.

title: 'Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Mochimaru Sakaki 's Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kouryaku Site" wo Mireru Sekai de Jiyuu ni Ikimasu ( The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ) revealed additional cast, staff, the theme songs, and first promotional video on Thursday.

The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 10.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11, TV Aichi, and MBS on October 8.

Voice actor Yuuto Uemura ( Bungou Stray Dogs 2nd Season ) is joining the cast as Reinhardt Highwind.

Staff Art Director: Asuka Komiyama ( Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta... ) Color Design: Megumi Aoi ( Kimi wo Aishita Hitori no Boku e digital paint) Director of Photography: Toshiyuki Sadamatsu ( Isekai Izakaya: Koto Aitheria no Izakaya Nobu ) Editing: Kumiko Sakamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Music: Alisa Okehazama ( Jujutsu Kaisen ), RYOSHI TAKAGI ( Isekai Tensei Soudouki ) Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera ( [Oshi no Ko] ) Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

Music group HoneyWorks ( Araburu Kisetsu no Otome-domo yo. ) is performing the opening theme "Eikyouryoku∞Idol feat. HaKoniwalily ." Rokudenashi ( Shuumatsu Train Doko e Iku? ) is performing the ending theme "Hoshi wo Meguru." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Jouji Furuta ( Shaman King (2021), Nanatsu no Taizai: Imashime no Fukkatsu ) is directing the anime at Bridge and Aisle . Shouji Yonemura ( Hotel Inhumans , Kiseijuu: Sei no Kakuritsu ) is handling the series composition. Yuuki Morimoto ( Bad Girl , Miss Monochrome The Animation ) is designing the characters.

Sakaki began penning the fantasy adventure series on both the Shousetsuka ni Narou and Kakuyomu websites simultaneously in May 2022. Square Enix began publishing the novel through its SQEX Novel imprint in December 2022, featuring illustrations by riritto . The fifth volume went on sale in May 2025.

Tamaki Toga began drawing a manga adaptation in Getsumaga Kichi magazine in May 2023. The 13th volume was released on August 7.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English in May 2025, and published the second volume on April 14. The third volume is scheduled to go on sale on November 10.

title: Danganronpa 2x2 Game's Switch 2 Release Changed to Game-Key Card
content:
Spike Chunsoft announced on Wednesday that the Switch 2 release of Danganronpa 2x2 , a version of its Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair game that includes the original title as well as a new alternate scenario, will shift to a game-key card release instead of a full game card.

Pre-orders for the Danganronpa 2x2 Psycho Tropical Vacation Package version of the game from the Spike Chunsoft Official Store US will be cancelled, and each customer must make a new pre-order for the game-key card version of the package. People who pre-ordered this package through other means will receive the game-key card version.

The company said that "this decision was not taken lightly and follows careful consideration," and added that this decision does not "affect the game's release or pre-orders for any other game platforms, or any other games."

Game-key cards are physical cartridges that do not actually contain a game, but rather, a key to unlock and play the digital version from Nintendo 's eShop.

Danganronpa 2x2 will launch in early 2027 for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The game was originally scheduled for 2026.

The release features a new alternate story featuring different victims and culprits from the original game, all stemming from a certain incident. The new scenario is titled “Slayhem” mode and will be about 35 hours long, five hours longer with 20% more content than the original game. Spike Chunsoft stated that the new story's content size is "on par" with the original. The original version of the game also receives new visuals and improved production value with the release.

The Danganronpa 2x2 Psycho Tropical Vacation Package includes am RSVLTS Reversible Psycho Tropical Hat, Kidrobot 3" Psycho Tropical Monokuma and Monomi Figures, a soundtrack, and a clamshell-style outer box.

The company announced last November that Kinuta Ōshiro will voice Monomi in place of late voice actress Takako Sasuga , and also announced last October that Wasabi Mizuta will voice Monokuma in place of late voice actress TARAKO .

Spike Chunsoft describes the original game:

Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun…until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island's mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair…

Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair originally launched in July 2012 for PlayStation Portable in Japan. The game launched for PlayStation Vita in Japan in October 2013 and in the West in September 2014. The game has received multiple ports since.

The Danganronpa Decadence game collection , which includes Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc Anniversary Edition , Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair , Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony , and the Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp bonus board game, shipped as a physical exclusive on Switch in North America and Europe in December 2021. The collection launched in Japan under the title Danganronpa Trilogy Pack + Happy Danganronpa S: Chōkōkōkyū no Nangoku Saikoro Kasshuku in November 2021. The games are also available separately digitally on Switch.

The franchise also includes a manga series, three television anime series, an anime special, and an original video anime ( OVA ) project.

The characters in Danganronpa 2 also star in the 2016 anime Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School: Despair Arc .

You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun…until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island's mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair…

Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair originally launched in July 2012 for PlayStation Portable in Japan. The game launched for PlayStation Vita in Japan in October 2013 and in the West in September 2014. The game has received multiple ports since.

The Danganronpa Decadence game collection , which includes Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc Anniversary Edition , Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair , Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony , and the Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp bonus board game, shipped as a physical exclusive on Switch in North America and Europe in December 2021. The collection launched in Japan under the title Danganronpa Trilogy Pack + Happy Danganronpa S: Chōkōkōkyū no Nangoku Saikoro Kasshuku in November 2021. The games are also available separately digitally on Switch.
The franchise also includes a manga series, three television anime series, an anime special, and an original video anime ( OVA ) project.
The characters in Danganronpa 2 also star in the 2016 anime Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School: Despair Arc .

title: The World's Strongest Witch Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita : Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu ) light novel series presented the main promotional video and main visual for the anime on Thursday. The video announces another cast member and additional staff members, and it also announces and previews the theme songs.

Yûto Uemura voices Reinhardt Highwind, the town's gatekeeper.

The newly announced staff members are:

• Art Director: Asuka Komiyama

• Color Key Artist: Megumi Aoi

• Compositing Director of Photography: Toshiyuki Sadamatsu

• Editing: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Music: Arisa Okehazama (The Apothecary Diaries, Jujutsu Kaisen), Ryoshi Takagi (Multi-Mind Mayhem: Isekai Tensei Soudouki)

• Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily perform the opening theme song "Eikyōryoku∞Idol" (Infinitely Influential Idol), and the group Rokudenashi performs the ending theme song "Hoshi o Muguru" (Traversing the Stars).

Yen Press is releasing the light novels in English, and released the second volume on April 14. Yen Press describes the story:

When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what “lmfao” means…

Previously announced cast members include:

Azusa Tachibana as protagonist Rona Hermit

Fairouz Ai as Erimina, the master of the adverturers' guild known as the "Inferno Witch"

Honoka Inoue as Eruna, an elf princess who worries over her sick mother

Kana Hanazawa as Aries Tear Bluemoon, a guildmaster in the port town of Aquas

Maria Naganawa as Ruru Ru Rie, the young water dragon princess of the underwater kingdom

Jōji Furuta ( ēlDLIVE , Double Decker! Doug & Kirill , Bad Girl ) is directing the anime at the studios Bridge and Aisle . Shoji Yonemura ( Pokémon Journeys: The Series , One Piece 2013-onwards, Bad Girl ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yūki Morimoto ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ , Boarding School Juliet , Bad Girl ) is designing the characters.

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX , BS11 , and TV Aichi channels on October 7, and on MBS on October 10.

Mochimaru Sakaki began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in May 2022. Square Enix published the first print novel volume in December 2022, with illustrations by riritto . The fifth novel volume shipped in May 2025.

Tamaki Toga launched a manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Getsu Maga Kichi/ Comic Days website in May 2023. Kodansha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on May 8.

Comikey publishes both Daisuke Takashima 's manga adaptation of Sakaki's The Strongest Swordsman Has Zero Equipment Slots novel series, as well as Namiki Tsukiyama 's manga adaptation of Sakaki's Final Boss Fake-out novel series in English. Square Enix also publishes both manga in English on its Manga UP! Global website.
author: ANN

title: The World’s Strongest Witch Reveals Main Trailer, Visual and Additional Cast, October 7 Premiere
content:
The World’s Strongest Witch anime has revealed its main trailer and visual ahead of its October 7, 2026 premiere. Yuto Uemura has also joined the cast as Reinhardt. Joji Furuta is directing the anime , with Shoji Yonemura in charge of the series composition and Yuki Morimoto as character designer. Studios Bridge and AISLE are in charge of the animation.

The trailer also previews both of the theme songs. HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily performs the opening theme song “Eikyoryoku ∞ Idol,” while Rokudenashi performs the ending theme “Hoshi o Meguru.” You can watch the new trailer below.

The main voice cast includes:

• Azusa Tachibana as Lorna Hermit

• Fairouz Ai as Elimina Manaflame

• Honoka Inoue as Erna

• Kana Hanazawa as Aries Tear Bluemoon

• Maria Naganawa as Ruru Ru Rie

The World’s Strongest Witch is based on the light novel by Mochimaru Sakaki and riritto, with a manga adaptation by Tamaki Toga. With no money or food, she’s about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna’s free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what “lmfao” means…

title: One Piece Elbaph Arc English Dub Begins October 20 With New Weekly Release Schedule, Heroines Dub Also Announced
content:
Toei Animation and Crunchyroll have announced that the ONE PIECE English dub will begin the Elbaph Arc on October 20, 2026, alongside a change to its release schedule. The companies also confirmed English, Spanish and Portuguese dubs for the ONE PIECE HEROINES episode.

Rather than releasing multiple dubbed episodes together in batches, as with previous ONE PIECE releases, Crunchyroll will move to a weekly schedule for the arc. Episode 1157 will follow one week later, with subsequent English-dubbed episodes releasing every Tuesday.

An English-dubbed clip from the upcoming arc was also released ahead of its premiere.

Before the Elbaph dub begins, ONE PIECE HEROINES will receive its English, Spanish and Portuguese dubs on October 13. The special follows Nami after a pair of shoes prevents her from stopping thieves. When she attempts to return them, the designer offers to create a replacement pair on the condition that she participates in an upcoming fashion show.

Both releases will stream on Crunchyroll in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia and Latin America.

Upcoming ONE PIECE Projects

• A new LEGO special animation project releasing with two episodes on September 29

• Season 3 of the live-action series is set for 2027, having revealed new Alabasta cast recently

• The franchise also has the upcoming remake anime by WIT Studio set to premiere in February 2027

• A new game titled ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet launching on October 23, 2026

• Two new anime films, with ONE PIECE FILM GOD VALLEY set for Summer 2027 and ONE PIECE FILM BAAD set for 2029
